permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends decoded Chirp codes to the Chirp server and receives the card to show. No audio is sent.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens for short Chirp tones from nearby phones, laptops and speakers. Audio is decoded in memory and never recorded or uploaded.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional: listens for Chirp tones through the phone microphone when the user picks phone listening. Audio is decoded in memory and never recorded or uploaded.
